name: Void Salvagers
legend: The salvage fleets of the Leagues of Votann secure material resources and recover stolen technologies. Their aggressive salvage operations bring them into conflict with hostile foes. It is fortunate, therefore, that Kin soldiers are well suited to combat in the close confines of space hulks and voidships.

rules.name: Stalwart Advance
rules.legend: The Kin proceed with steadfast determination, exterminating all resistance and securing decks one at a time. Aggressively yet methodically, resistance is swept aside.
rules.description_html: In your Shooting phase, each time a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army has shot, if one or more enemy units were destroyed by those attacks and that LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 3" and can then attempt to operate a Hatchway.

stratagems.name: CORRIDOR COVERED
stratagems.legend: As their allies push forwards, Kin squads train their guns down darkened corridors, preparing to repel unexpected ambushes.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your opponent's Movement or Charge phase.

TARGET: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not fired Overwatch this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack while firing Overwatch, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ is required to score a hit, instead of an unmodified 6.

stratagems.name: JUDGED AND PUNISHED
stratagems.legend: To draw the ire of the Kin is to invite a swift and brutal death.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, if the target has 1 or more Judgement tokens, you can re-roll the Hit roll, and if the target has 2 Judgement tokens, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.

stratagems.name: POINT-BLANK FIRE
stratagems.legend: The Kin are well used to working in close confines and can fire their ranged weapons with precision even within the restrictive corridors of a voidship.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One HEARTHKYN WARRIORS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] ability.

stratagems.name: RELIC CYPHER
stratagems.legend: The Kin possess the accumulated knowledge of their ancestors, including ancient cyphers that enable them to seize control of cogitational systems.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one closed Hatchway on the battlefield and open it.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once.

enhancements.name: Masterful Construction
enhancements.legend: The weapons utilised by the Kin are wrought by expert craftsmen and are as versatile as they are deadly.
enhancements.description_html: Each time the bearer is selected to shoot or fight, you can select one of the following weapon abilities: [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]; [LETHAL HITS]; [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by the bearer (excluding Psychic weapons) have that ability.

enhancements.name: Obsessive Drive
enhancements.legend: The bearer seeks a specific item that lies in the hands of the foe and they will not rest until it has been secured. Those foes foolish enough to block the path are targeted for priority destruction.
enhancements.description_html: At the start of the first battle round, select one objective marker. While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time a LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, each enemy unit within range of that objective marker is considered to have 1 additional Judgement token while resolving those attacks.
